data.name: Shaurya
data.gender_notes: Shaurya is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Shaurya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shaurya' meaning 'King, Ruler, Lord'. In Hindu mythology, Shaurya is the name of a demon king from the Mahabharata epic. It is also a popular given name for boys in India. The name Shaurya carries the meaning “King, Ruler, Lord” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Shaurya usually hope their child will grow to embody king, ruler, lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Shaurya belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “King, Ruler, Lord.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shaurya total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
